source_of_truth: README.tr.md 'Doğrulama' table for the legacy ids; this file for iteration-24
note: Iteration-24 live regression set (Claude + OpenCode; budget-first pool BUD1, OpenCode-by-default badge SM1, free lane FR1, Gemini slot GM1). The goldens are derived from SKILL.md's rules and were confirmed by a cold-agent run (iteration-24: 33/33, i1 not run) — re-run with fresh agents and grade with grade_routing.py after any rule change. `golden_output` is the output the rules should produce; `python grade_routing.py --selftest --results-dir /tmp/x` proves the grader and the goldens agree. `allow_gemini: true` marks the evals where Rule GM1 lets Gemini 4 Argon onto the OpenCode line. The iteration-20 (Codex) set is archived under archive/iteration-20-codex/routing/.
